deviations.desc_id: RH zona A3 Coating 55,6–55,9 %RH dan ΔP 8,6–9,1 Pa selama ±30 menit saat hujan deras; pintu D-A3-1 tidak menutup rapat. Terjadi di mode Shadow (BMS statis); AI mencatat TAHAN dan prediksi ekskursi.
deviations.desc_en: Zone A3 film coating reached 55.6–55.9 %RH and ΔP 8.6–9.1 Pa for about 30 minutes during heavy rain; door D-A3-1 did not close fully. This happened in Shadow mode (static BMS control); the AI logged HOLD and forecast the excursion.

categories.Metode: Belum ada alarm pintu terbuka > 60 detik

root_id.primary: Door closer D-A3-1 aus sehingga pintu tidak menutup rapat

actions: Verifikasi ΔP & RH 3 hari setelah perbaikan
Tambah alarm pintu terbuka > 60 detik di BMS
Aktifkan notifikasi prediksi ekskursi RUAIX ke QA

en.root: Door closer on D-A3-1 worn, so the door did not close fully.
ca: Verify ΔP and RH for 3 days after repair
pa: Add a door-open > 60 s alarm in the BMS
Send RUAIX excursion forecasts to QA

deviations.desc_id: Transmitter RHT-B3 drift +1,7 s.d. +2,9 %RH. Penilaian dampak: RH aktual (estimasi AHU & model) tetap dalam batas; tidak ada batch terdampak.
deviations.desc_en: Transmitter RHT-B3 drifted +1.7 to +2.9 %RH. Impact assessment: actual RH (AHU estimate and model) stayed within limits; no batch affected.

root_id.primary: Drift sensor kapasitif RH di area berdebu tinggi

actions: Interval kalibrasi RHT di zona penimbangan 6 → 3 bulan
Tambah sensor RH redundan di B3

en.root: Capacitive RH sensor drift in a high-dust area (as found +2.9 %RH).
pa: Calibration interval for RH transmitters in dispensing: 6 → 3 months
Add a redundant RH sensor in B3

deviations.desc_id: ΔP airlock A4 turun ke 4,1–4,6 Pa (batas min 5 Pa) karena interlock pintu gagal; dua pintu terbuka bersamaan. Investigasi berjalan.
deviations.desc_en: Airlock A4 ΔP dropped to 4.1–4.6 Pa (minimum 5 Pa) because the door interlock failed and both doors opened together. Investigation in progress.

root_id.primary_hypothesis: Relay interlock pintu airlock IL-A4-DOORS gagal

actions: Uji fungsi interlock harian selama 7 hari (usulan)
Masukkan uji interlock ke PM bulanan (usulan)

en.root: Hypothesis (AI draft): relay of airlock door interlock IL-A4-DOORS failed.
ca: Daily interlock function test for 7 days (proposed)
pa: Add interlock test to monthly preventive maintenance (proposed)
